NP Presspad 1.4.2 — Maintenance

Maintenance release — dependency updates only, no user-facing changes. **No companion plugin update needed.**

This release refreshes the libraries NP Presspad is built on. Everything here is under the hood; the app looks and works exactly as before.

## Dependency updates

- **Rich text editor (Tiptap)** 3.33.0 → 3.34.0 — the editor at the heart of writing and formatting your posts, with the latest upstream fixes; all `@tiptap/*` packages moved together.
- **Electron** 45.2.3 → 45.3.2 — the application framework (Chromium + Node.js runtime), with the latest fixes from the Electron 45 line.
- **Database engine (better-sqlite3-multiple-ciphers)** 13.0.3 → 13.1.1 — the encrypted local store that keeps your posts and drafts safe offline.
- **Icons (Lucide)** 1.70.0 → 1.73.0 — the icon set used across the interface.
- **Markdown parser (marked)** 18.1.3 → 18.2.0 — used when rendering and converting content to Markdown.
- **HTML sanitizer (sanitize-html)** 2.18.1 → 2.18.2 — cleans incoming HTML so pasted and imported content stays safe.
- **Image cropping (react-easy-crop)** 6.2.4 → 6.2.5 — the crop tool used when preparing images.
- **Build & test tooling** — Vite 8.3.6 → 8.3.8 and the React build plugin 6.2.1 → 6.3.0. Development tooling only; none of it ships in the app.
